Name: Skulldogs
Author: maxdri01
Description:
Just a small, purely cosmetic mod that turns all skeletons (including haunted skulls, dangerous versions, skeleton furniture and mask) into skulldogs.

﻿Pairs nicely with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url], since it changes all NPCs, but leaves some monsters still "human-like", specially skeletons.
